main_measure.name: t of the slope of the 5-bar excess return on the forecast, grid bars with forecast > 0, clustered by day

statistic.name: OLS slope t, errors clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with the supporting check), t <= -2 rejects, at least 200 grid bars with a positive forecast

supporting_check.name: mean unusual 5-bar move of the cases (forecast rises >= 2 points, once per grid cell), long direction, > 0

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The regression uses an intercept and CR1 day-clustered errors on grid bars (positions 0,5,10,... of each window) with post_pipeline_value > 0 and a 5-bar forward return inside the window, the drift is the coin's mean 5-bar grid return over all its windows, the cases are the first forecast rise of at least 2 points per grid cell, and the plan's 'fewer than 200 grid bars' is reported as not observable.
